slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

extent.instructions: Only when the action scrolls the page or a scrolling part of it: how far? Choose words when the words give a number of screens or pages; screen when they say nothing of how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as many screens as the number the words carry
options.little: a little: a third of a screen
options.screen: one screen, as Page Down does
options.end: all the way: to the bottom, or to the top going up

where.instructions: Where do the words point: at something on this page, at something on playwright.dev that is not on this page, or somewhere else on the web?

options.page: on this page: one of the numbered refs
options.site: on playwright.dev but not on this page: a page, a person, a post, a section of it
options.web: elsewhere: another website, or a search of the whole web

outcome.instructions: Is what the user asked for done? First: if a pop-up, sign-in prompt or challenge covers the page now, choose in_the_way; a cookie strip or other notice on the page that covers nothing is not in the way. Otherwise judge by their words and Done so far, not by the page alone: choose yes when the page shows what they asked to see (for a question, when Text in view states its answer), or Done so far shows the action they asked for has happened; not_yet when more steps are needed.

options.yes: done: the page shows it or its answer, or the action they asked for has happened
options.in_the_way: a pop-up or prompt covers the page now
options.not_yet: not done: more to do, nothing covering the page

progress.instructions: Did the last action in Done so far bring the page closer to what the user's words ask for? Judge by what it did and the page now: closer when it did part or all of what they asked, or opened the way to it; not closer when what changed is not what they asked for.

passage.instructions: Which block of Text in view states what the user asked to know, in the page's own words? Choose none when no block states it, or when the user asked for an action and nothing to be told.
